'''Half Tail''' is sour [[wolf]] and pack leader.

==Activities==
Half Tail, along with [[Two Moons]], [[Wildfire]], [[Old Deer]], [[Rabbit Nose]], [[Morning Clouds]], and numerous other wolves are known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. They scout for Perrin when he is searching for [[Rand al'Thor]] after Rand was kidnapped by [[Aes Sedai]] loyalists.{{ref/book|6|54}}
